question: Does the exact first-party Kodak VISION3 250D sheet expose reproducible channel-wise diffuse-rms granularity versus log exposure, under the stated ECN-2, Status-M and 48-micrometre-aperture context, sufficient for a later same-sheet MTF/granularity compatibility test?

branch_rule.pass: Freeze a separate no-rescue compatibility experiment that fits only amplitude on a development exposure subset and tests the fixed P5J spatial response plus a characteristic-slope variance family on disjoint exposure points.
branch_rule.fail: Close before any joint model; do not repair points, axes or gates after inspecting the report.

forbidden: fit a grain model while selecting source pixels
treat 48-micrometre Sigma-D as a full NPS or scanner-independent emulsion spectrum
change trace points after the source report is inspected
claim a particular roll, process session, scanner, calibrated stock or product profile
claim_ceiling: First-party manufacturer-graph observation of typical Kodak VISION3 250D diffuse-rms granularity under one stated ECN-2/Status-M/48-micrometre context; not full NPS, particular-roll evidence, calibration or product evidence.
